rows.name: Stone Knuckle
rows.notes: Grounded boulder core, broad blunt fists and planted stone feet replace the winged/floating proxy. Individual stones and moss are simplified; pose-tested joints remain visibly assembled.

rows.name: Kobold Tunnel Scout
rows.notes: Reptilian muzzle, contrasting eyes, horns/ridges, weighted tail, claws, scout clothing, launcher, chalk/twine and ribbon replace the orc proxy. Body is chunkier than the narrow-shouldered illustration; folds, scales and grip detail remain simplified.

rows.name: Plague Zombie
rows.notes: Exposed corpse flesh, hooked claws, dark facial recesses, ragged partial hood and burial strips replace the healthy human costume. Revision corrected floating head and clean-mummy reading. Gauntness, organic anatomy and mottled disease detail still need refinement.
